column1: # Published metrics for Melampsora allii-populina 12AY07, transcribed from Table 2 of
# Duplessis et al., G3 2026, doi:10.1093/g3journal/jkag247 ("Assembly metrics of Melampsora
# allii-populina genome version 2"). Reference targets for the validation run.
# HOW TO COMPARE. As for mlp (see reference_metrics_mlp98AG31.tsv): H0/H1 are Hi-C SCAFFOLDED
# to 18 scaffolds each, so contig-level rows compare to assembly_summary.tsv and scaffold-level
# Method differences that matter more here than for mlp. The paper scaffolded 12AY07 with
# HapHiC (36 chromosomes, diploid) on a first-round NuclearPhaser assembly, then MANUALLY
# corrected it: dot-plot comparison, re-ordering against M. lini haplotype C, RagTag correct
# and scaffold, and a second NuclearPhaser pass. This pipeline does none of the manual steps,
# so the scaffold rows are a ceiling, not a target. Contigs under 2x coverage were also
# BUSCO complete is asymmetric (90.7 vs 86.1%); do not read a hap2 deficit here as our error
# without checking the published H1 first.
# v1 is the PREVIOUS reference (collapsed, fragmented), kept as the floor to beat.
# unphased is the 8.53 Mb of contigs v2 could not assign to a haplotype; it is not a target.
